summary: The Mach-O LC_MAIN entry routine is named `main` through the existing entry_names overlay and declared `int main(int argc, char **argv)`, so a stripped macOS binary stops reporting the one function an agent needs first as one more sub_<addr> in an inventory of them.

decisions.what: the filed hypothesis STANDS, and the address half was already there
decisions.detail: Filed: 'entrymainproto handles CRT call-site recovery but the Mach-O LC_MAIN loader path does not label/type the entry routine.' Correct as stated. What the reproduction added is that kuna's Mach-O entry oracle 1 (macho_entry.rs) ALREADY reads LC_MAIN and already discovers __TEXT.vmaddr + entryoff as a function start -- crackme0x04's sub_100003a80 IS that address. Only the name and the prototype were missing, which is why this is a naming/prototype pass over an address the loader hands it rather than any new discovery.

decisions.what: default-ON is forced by the acceptance probe, and the four gates cannot vouch for it
decisions.detail: The acceptance runs plain `kuna functions <bin> --json` with no --option, so a default-OFF option cannot close the need. The captain's B_PLAN note is right that '0/675 assertions changed' is NOT evidence here: both parity corpora are symbol-less ELF bytechunks, so no Mach-O loader/naming change can move them in either direction. The evidence supplied instead is the 23-image Mach-O sweep below, the three-test end-to-end two-pass gate in kuna-console, the four unit tests over the pure seam, and the promoted tests/cli probe on a new in-repo stripped Mach-O fixture.

The Mach-O leading underscore is the assembler's C-symbol decoration. kuna already strips it for IMPORTS (macho_stubs::strip_leading_underscore) but not for defined symbols, which is why the unstripped twin reports `_main`. This pass mints the C name directly. Consequence worth naming: the acceptance's filed regex `name.*main` is satisfied by `_main` too, so the promoted probe tightens it to the exact `"name": "main"` line plus the absence of the pre-fix `sub_1000005b0` -- otherwise it would go green on an unstripped image that never exercised the pass.

decisions.what: typed int/char** where entrymainproto deliberately refuses to
decisions.detail: The PE pass reports the WIDTHS its recovered call site establishes and will not assert the C library's declaration, because the same call shape carries wmain's wchar_t **. LC_MAIN carries no such ambiguity -- the field is documented as the offset of main() and dyld calls it as main(argc, argv, envp, apple) -- so int/char ** is the honest spelling and it lets a string literal render through argv[i]. envp is deliberately NOT declared: dyld does pass it (and a fourth `apple` pointer) but the extra unused slots cost more noise than they buy, and a main that really reads envp still shows the third argument register in its body.

Same reason as the sibling analysis-tier options (widestrings, noreturn_propagate, relocobjects): the stages corpus is symbol-less bytechunks that carry no load commands at all, so a Mach-O container fact cannot be expressed there. Coverage is decompiler/crates/kuna-console/tests/verify_machomain.rs (the two-pass gate, plus the named-twin guard), four unit tests over entry_main_vma / macho_main_entry_vma, and the promoted CLI probe.

decisions.what: the acceptance target is dataset-only, so a stripped Mach-O fixture was vendored
decisions.detail: `verify --promote` refuses a `binary_source: dataset` target because CI has no dataset, and every in-repo Mach-O fixture carried its own `_main` symbol -- i.e. was a NEGATIVE case for this pass. macho_stripped_main is macho_imports with the defined-symbol names taken away (survivors reordered, nsyms shortened, LC_DYSYMTAB index windows and the indirect-symbol table renumbered, export trie emptied), every offset and the file size preserved. macho_stripped_main.py beside it regenerates it byte-identically, and the pair is now the positive/negative twin for the same test.

collateral_sweep.method: kuna decompile-all, machomain on (default) vs --option machomain off, over every Mach-O image in the RE dataset (23 files: x86_64, arm64, i386, ppc, thin and fat). Every changed line of every changed binary was read.
collateral_sweep.refusals_accounted: 12 already carry a _main symbol at the LC_MAIN address (a named entry is never overwritten); 3 are LC_UNIXTHREAD-only pre-10.8 images whose entry is the crt's `start`, not `main`, so nothing is claimed. Zero unexplained misses and zero false fires.
collateral_sweep.worst_case: FallingWhale and crackme0x04 each gain one argument at a callee kuna has no prototype for -- `___chkstk_darwin(CONCAT44(v7,argc))` and `sub_100003790(CONCAT44(v11,argc))`. Declaring argc makes the first ABI argument register live at main's own entry, so an unprototyped callee reached with it renders the value. This is the standing behaviour the PE entrymainproto pass already documents and measures at 4 of its 30 firing images; the real answer is prototype coverage at the callee, not withholding the entry declaration.

cost.method: interleaved min-of-N, 15 alternating pairs (order flipped every pair) plus 3 warmup pairs, `kuna decompile crackme0x04 --addr 0x100003a80 --option machomain on|off` -- the address form on BOTH arms so the selector is identical
cost.note: one extra walk of the load-command list at LOAD (16 commands on the witness) and one prototype park -- no decode, no p-code, no per-function work, so a delta under 1% is what the mechanism predicts.
cost.timeit_caveat: scripts.pipeline.timeit run sequentially on this box reported -23.57% (off=166.98, on=127.62) over 9 repeats -- it times ALL the off repeats and then all the on repeats, so a warming trend lands entirely on the second arm. Its own name-first/address-fallback selection is a second hazard here: with `--selector main` the OFF arm cannot resolve the name (that is the defect) and silently falls back to the address form. The interleaved figures above are the ones to believe; they agree with the mechanism.

not_closed: LC_UNIXTHREAD-only images (pre-10.8 ppc/i386 Mach-O, 3 of the 23 swept) still report their entry as sub_<addr>. That entry is the crt's `start` and NOT main, so naming it `main` would be wrong; recovering main from it means following the crt, which is a different pass.

A defined Mach-O symbol still reports with its leading underscore (`_main`, `_compute`). Stripping it for defined symbols the way macho_stubs already does for imports is a separate naming-policy change and is not made here.

The old `sub_<addr>` spelling is not kept as an alias, so `kuna decompile <bin> sub_100003a80` no longer resolves on a firing image (--addr does). Ghidra and IDA behave the same way, but an agent that recorded the anonymous name before the fix will have to re-look-up.
envp and the fourth `apple` pointer dyld passes are not declared (see decisions).
The two spurious call-site arguments are NOT fixed here -- they are a prototype-coverage gap at the callee that predates this pass.
